title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Nottingham

£45,343 - £51,937 per annum


Help us build the data foundations for NCHA’s future


We’re investing in how we use data across NCHA and are looking for an experienced Lead Data Engineer to take a key role in developing our data warehouse, pipelines and wider data platform.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys building reliable, scalable data solutions that people trust and use, while also having the opportunity to shape how our data engineering capability develops.


You’ll act as NCHA’s technical lead, working to connect data from our core systems, creating well-engineered, production-ready datasets that support Power BI, analytics and better decision-making across NCHA.


You won’t simply maintain an established platform. You’ll help shape our architecture, establish engineering standards and influence how our data platform evolves as we deliver our Data & Insight Strategy. As a regulated organisation, data quality, security, governance and reliability are central to everything we do.


What you’ll be doing


Working closely with our Information and Intelligence team, Technology colleagues, business teams and suppliers, you’ll:


  • Lead the technical development and ongoing improvement of our data warehouse and data platform.
  • Design, build and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple source systems.
  • Use technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Microsoft Fabric to develop scalable data solutions.
  • Develop well-modelled, reusable datasets that provide a trusted foundation for Power BI, reporting and analytics.
  • Build data quality, validation and reconciliation into our engineering processes.
  • Establish good engineering practices, including Git, CI/CD, code review and separation of development, test and production environments.
  • Ensure pipelines are designed with performance, reliability, security and cost efficiency in mind.
  • Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and technical standards.
  • Work with system owners and suppliers to ensure new systems integrate effectively with our wider data architecture.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching and knowledge sharing across the Data & Insight team.


What we’re looking for


You’ll be an experienced data engineer with strong technical foundations, a practical mindset and the confidence to take technical ownership.


You will have experience in:


  • Building and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling.
  • Modern cloud data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure.
  • Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Data warehousing and integrating data from multiple systems.
  • Data quality, reconciliation, monitoring and automation.
  • Git, source control and CI/CD approaches.
  • Working with Power BI and analytical data models.
  • Developing secure, reliable and scalable data solutions.
  • Explaining technical concepts clearly and working collaboratively with technical and non-technical colleagues.


Why Join NCHA?


This is an opportunity to do more than build pipelines.


You’ll help shape the technical foundations for how NCHA uses data, connecting information across our organisation and helping us move towards a trusted, scalable and increasingly automated data environment.


Your work will enable colleagues to spend less time extracting, preparing and checking data and more time using insight to understand our customers and homes, improve services, manage risk and make better decisions.


Come and shape what’s next


If you’re looking for a role where you can bring your technical expertise, influence our direction and see the impact of what you build, this could be the opportunity for you.


What we can offer you


  • Flexible working: We operate hybrid working, with colleagues expected to work in the office three days per week and remotely for the remainder of the week.
  • Generous annual leave: You'll receive 36.5 days annual leave (including bank holidays), increasing to 38.5 days after five years' service.
  • Excellent pension scheme: We offer a generous pension scheme with employer contributions of up to 10%.
  • Learning and development: We invest in our people, offering a wide variety of internal training courses each year, alongside access to professional qualifications, specialist training and conferences.
  • Family-friendly and flexible benefits: We provide enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption benefits, as well as policies that help colleagues balance work with caring and family responsibilities
  • Health and wellbeing support: Our wellbeing package includes cashback on dental and optical treatments, access to specialist consultations and therapies, and a 24-hour counselling service.
